data.name: Safiya
data.gender_notes: Safiya is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Safiya is an Arabic name that means 'pure and untainted'. It is also the name of one of the Prophet Muhammad's wives, known for her piety and kindness. The name Safiya carries the meaning “Pure and Untainted” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Safiya usually hope their child will grow to embody pure and untainted and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Safiya is also considered a symbol of spiritual purity and innocence in Islamic tradition.
data.etymology: Safiya belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Pure and Untainted.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Safiya total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_english.name: Safiya
in_english.meaning: Safiya means pure, chaste, and free from impurities
in_english.long_meaning: Safiya is a feminine given name derived from the Arabic root 's-f-y', which means pure, chaste, and free from impurities. The name Safiya is mentioned in the Quran and is associated with spiritual purity, innocence, and devotion. It is a popular name among Muslims worldwide, symbolizing a person's commitment to a life of righteousness and moral integrity.

data.cultural_impact: The name Safiya holds a special place in Islamic culture, not only due to its meaning- 'pure and untainted', but also because it is the name of one of the Prophet Muhammad's most beloved wives. Safiya bint Huyayy ibn Akhtab was accepted into the Prophet's household after the Battle of Khaybar, and her beauty, intelligence, and piety became the subject of many hadiths, showcasing her prominent role in early Islamic history. Today, Safiya serves as an inspiration for Muslim women to strive for purity and righteousness in their daily lives.
data.spiritual_significance: For Muslims, the name Safiya holds deep spiritual significance, symbolizing the purity and closeness to Allah that every believer aspires to achieve. It is a reminder that no matter what external influences or adversities we may face, the essential goal is to maintain a heart free from sin and impurities. The Prophet Muhammad himself expressed the importance of this quality: "The believing man or woman keeps their heart free from Allah's displeasure as a falcon guarding its eggs." By bearing the name Safiya, one is continuously encouraged to strive towards this ideal.
